indicator_name: IMF WEO for all economies: GDP growth, inflation, GDP in USD and PPP, population, current account, debt, unemployment
description: МВФ WEO по всем странам: рост ВВП, инфляция, ВВП в долларах и по ППС, население, счёт текущих операций, долг, безработица
unit: as named in item_name (percent; billions of USD; USD; international dollars; millions of persons; percent of GDP; index)
geography: All economies (IMF WEO; country groups excluded)
methodology: Item COUNTRY.INDICATOR (ISO3 . WEO code): NGDP_RPCH real GDP growth, PCPIPCH / PCPIEPCH CPI inflation (average / end of period), NGDPD GDP in billions of USD, NGDPDPC per capita USD, PPPPC per capita PPP, LP population (millions), BCA_NGDPD current account % of GDP, GGXWDG_NGDP gross government debt % of GDP, LUR unemployment, NGDP_D deflator. Latest WEO vintage in the API (October 2025 on 2026-09-27); only outturns are kept (years before each country's COUNTRY_UPDATE_DATE year). 1980 onward; the CIS mostly from 1992-1993 (no Russia 1992 growth). IMF staff figures, often different from national data in the 1990s (Kyrgyzstan 1993 -13.0 vs official -15.5; Kazakhstan CPI 1994 1 402% vs BNS 1 877%); for the CIS prefer CIS_* (CIS Stat). The Kazakh IMF_* scalars come from the same flow.
